summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed an Item 8.01 8-K announcing a board-declared cash dividend on its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock (CHAD). The board declared $0.07944 per CHAD share for the period from September 8, 2026 issuance through October 1, 2026, plus daily dividends of $0.00516 per share for each of 21 business days from October 1, 2026 through October 30, 2026, a 13.00% annualized rate. Record dates precede each payment by one business day. No advisor, premium, or structural mechanics disclosed. Risk-arb angle: none; routine dividend notice.
